title: 脉冲神经网络中的替代函数优化笔记
excerpt: 围绕膜电位分布与替代梯度函数设计，整理 SNN 训练稳定性和梯度传播中的关键问题。
content:
问题背景

脉冲发放函数不可导，使得 SNN 的反向传播需要借助替代梯度。替代函数的形状、宽度和膜电位分布之间的匹配关系，会直接影响训练稳定性。

记录重点

后续可以在这里展开整理 AAAI 2026 工作中的动机、公式推导、实验现象和复现实验设置。

en.title: Notes on surrogate-function optimization in spiking neural networks
en.excerpt: Membrane-potential distributions, surrogate-gradient design, and their role in training stability and gradient propagation.
en.content:
Background

The spike-generation function is not differentiable, so SNN backpropagation relies on surrogate gradients. The alignment between surrogate shape, width, and the membrane-potential distribution directly influences training stability.

Reading focus

Further notes may develop the motivation, derivations, experimental observations, and reproduction settings of the AAAI 2026 work.
